The Finance Engineering team is at the core of Stripe to empower business\\-critical financial domains including Accounting, Finance operations, Finance and Strategy, and Treasury.  As part of the Marketing Systems team, you own systems that power go\\-to\\-market motions productizing gathered insights and intelligence. This includes building tools that 1/ power better digital experiences, 2/ accelerate customer journey with intelligent orchestrations, 3/ drive smarter decisions with CDP, and 4/ improve marketer and seller productivity.
   

  

 What you'll do

**Minimum Requirements**
